task: Build a per-carrier Starbreaker gravitational-wave candidate ledger
scientific_question: Which individual Starbreaker carrier occurrences reinforce, cancel, or negligibly affect the aggregate internal quadrupole-power proxy, and do any frozen carrier identities remain positive across discovery, validation, final, localized, and dispersed scenario partitions?
hypothesis: The already-frozen bind/escape histories contain a reproducible carrier identity whose exact leave-one-out contribution to the internal Starbreaker quadrupole-power proxy is positive across held doors and both geometries.
null_hypothesis: Occurrence-level contributions can be computed, but no carrier identity remains directionally positive across the frozen held partitions.

source_definition.flow: The sealed CR005d post-collapse continuous flow from collapse state xc to final state x1.
source_definition.origin: The time-dependent equal-occurrence centroid of all roster atoms in the scenario.
source_definition.origin_boundary: This is a zero-fit translation-invariant reference, not a physical mass center because no mass weights are supplied.
source_definition.carrier_quadrupole: For centered carrier position r_i, Q_i = r_i r_i^T - (|r_i|^2/3) I, stored as xx,yy,zz,xy,xz,yz.
source_definition.source_tensor: J_i = d^3 Q_i / ds^3 on the frozen dimensionless post-collapse coordinate s.
source_definition.integration_window: Fine-grid samples 3 through N-3 inclusive of Python slice 3:-3, matching the sealed CR005d derivative boundary exclusion.
source_definition.interpretation: Positive DeltaP_i is an aggregate-source reinforcer; negative DeltaP_i is an aggregate-source canceller. This is source attribution, not a claim that the carrier is gravitational-wave material or a propagating messenger.

history_definition.authority: The sealed CR005d per-carrier timing ledger.

candidate_rules.door_stability: Median DeltaP_i/P_all is positive independently in discovery, validation, and final.
candidate_rules.geometry_stability: Median DeltaP_i/P_all is positive independently in localized_ledger_cells and dispersed_slots.
candidate_rules.strong_candidate: Population requirements, all three door medians, and both geometry medians pass.
candidate_rules.directional_candidate: Population requirements and all three door medians pass, but one or more geometry medians do not.
candidate_rules.slot_ranking: Descending worst-door median DeltaP_i/P_all, then overall median, then ascending ledger_slot.
candidate_rules.occurrence_shortlist: Top 200 positive-reinforcement occurrences by DeltaP_i/P_all, descending with deterministic scenario_id and atom_index ties.

required_controls: sealed source custody before and after execution
direct leave-one-out agreement with 2I-P on a deterministic prefix
global translation invariance after centroid subtraction
finite positive aggregate source in all scenarios
no external waveform, QNM filter, fitted parameter, physical strain, or registry mutation
